hypothesis: Broader image-grounded supervised LoRA adaptation improves whole-answer VQA over the same pretrained model with a matched short-answer prompt; prompt-only gains are reported separately.

data.split: Official train only, filename-source-group hash separation; no official validation/evaluation data in training or checkpoint selection

resource_fallbacks.selection: Resource failures only, before measured arms; every measured arm uses the chosen fixed settings

selection.metric: normalised whole-answer exact match on held-out official-training images

final_evaluation.support: Entire pinned VRSBench_EVAL_vqa.json, with all expected questions in denominator
final_evaluation.official_gpt_judge: Not run without separate paid-API authorization; export predictions without claiming published GPT scores
final_evaluation.historical_exposure: Existing 2026-09 VRSBench diagnostics are disclosed; no pristine full-test claim
final_evaluation.labels: Acquire/open final references only after candidate and inference settings are frozen; never pass references into inference prompts
